section_header: FRONT AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Front Axle Hub
title: Front Axle Hub

content.description: Cross-section view of front axle hub showing screwdriver prying out oil seal and removing inner bearing

items.title: REMOVE INNER BEARING AND OIL SEAL
steps: (a) Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.
(b) Remove the inner bearing from the disc.

content.description: Front axle hub assembly showing spindle and bearing arrangement in sectional view

content.text: INSPECTION AND REPAIR OF FRONT AXLE HUB

items.title: INSPECT SPINDLE
items.text: Using a magnetic flaw detector or flaw detecting penetrant, check for damage or cracks.

content.description: Diagram showing outer and inner bearing races with arrows indicating inspection points

items.title: INSPECT BEARING
items.text: Clean the bearing and outer races and inspect them for wear or damage.

items.title: REPLACE BEARING OUTER RACE
steps: (a) Using a brass bar and hammer, drive out the bearing outer race.

content.description: Illustration showing SST (Special Service Tool) being used to install new bearing outer race

content.text: (b) Using SST, carefully drive in a new bearing outer race.
